task: ae.vcs content-addressed repository with commit DAG, merge-base and three-way merge
reasoning_summary: Designed ports (ObjectStore, Refs) with memory and atomic file adapters, canonical object encodings and a Repo for commit/log/mergeBase/merge/fsck. Tests combine SHA-256 literals, corruption loops, a merge truth table and seeded brute-force oracles for mergeBase, log and merge. Mutation checks on merge rules, log ordering and fast-forward detection were each caught.
